sections.title: Fix before launch
sections.intro: These stop pages from being crawled or indexed, or break every share of a page.

items.title: Put the canonical link in the served HTML
items.detail: The canonical is added by react-helmet after load. Fixed by prerendering, or set it per route in the prerendered HTML.

items.title: Write a meta description for each page
items.detail: No page has one. One or two sentences each, about 150 characters.

items.title: Add a favicon
items.detail: /favicon.ico answers with the app shell, so search results and tabs show a generic globe. The brand-kit icons skill makes the full set.

items.title: Prerender the public pages
items.detail: Every page is an empty <div id="root"> until JavaScript runs. Google renders it later, but Slack, Facebook, LinkedIn and AI crawlers see nothing. Prerender the five public routes at build time.

items.title: Generate a sitemap
items.detail: /sitemap.xml returns the app shell. Generate one at build time from the route list and add a Sitemap: line to robots.txt.

items.title: Add og:description
items.detail: Shared links show no summary.

items.title: Add a share image
items.detail: No og:image on any page, so shared links show no picture. Use the cover-art share image for project pages and a brand-kit image for the rest.

items.title: Return a real 404 for unknown URLs
items.detail: Any made-up URL answers 200 with the home page shell. Add a 404.html and stop rewriting every path to index.html.

sections.title: Polish
sections.intro: Small things worth doing while you are in the code.

items.title: No apple-touch-icon (180×180 PNG) for iOS home screens and iMessage link previews
items.detail: No apple-touch-icon (180×180 PNG) for iOS home screens and iMessage link previews.

items.title: No <meta name="theme-color">
items.detail: No <meta name="theme-color">; mobile browser bars and some link previews (Discord) use it for the accent colour.

items.title: 1 page(s) have no <a href> links until JavaScript runs
items.detail: 1 page(s) have no <a href> links until JavaScript runs.

items.title: No robots.txt (404)
items.detail: No robots.txt (404). Crawlers treat that as "allow all"; add one with a Sitemap: line.

items.title: No og:title
items.detail: No og:title; Facebook, Slack and LinkedIn fall back to <title>, which usually carries the site-name suffix.

items.title: No twitter:card
items.detail: No twitter:card; X shows at most a small card. Use summary_large_image for a full-width image.

items.title: JavaScript changes the title from "Vite App" to "Portfolio of Someone - projects and writing"
items.detail: JavaScript changes the title from "Vite App" to "Portfolio of Someone - projects and writing"; non-rendering crawlers see the first.

items.title: Title is only 8 characters
items.detail: Title is only 8 characters: "Vite App".

sections.title: Set up once
sections.intro: No crawl can see these. Tick what is already done.

items.title: Verify the site in Google Search Console
items.detail: Add a Domain property and verify it with the DNS TXT record, so every protocol and subdomain is covered.

items.title: Submit the sitemap in Search Console
items.detail: Sitemaps → add the sitemap URL. Then check Pages → "Why pages aren't indexed" a few days later.

items.title: Add the site to Bing Webmaster Tools
items.detail: Import it from Search Console in one step, then submit the sitemap. Bing feeds DuckDuckGo, Yahoo, Copilot and several AI search products.
items.note: Import from Search Console once the sitemap is live

items.title: Decide on IndexNow
items.detail: Optional: tells Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver about changed pages straight away (not Google). Worth it for sites that publish often.

items.title: Link profiles both ways
items.detail: List the GitHub, LinkedIn and social profiles in the Person or Organization JSON-LD sameAs, and link each profile back to the site. For Mastodon, add <link rel="me"> and <meta name="fediverse:creator"> to the home page.

items.title: Make organic search traffic measurable
items.detail: Vercel Web Analytics referrers, GA4 or Plausible: something that separates search traffic, so the next audit can show what changed.

items.title: Share the home page once on each platform
items.detail: Paste the link in a Slack DM to yourself and run it through the Facebook Sharing Debugger and LinkedIn Post Inspector, which also refresh their caches.

items.title: Keep redirects for old URLs
items.detail: When routes change or the site moves domain, 301 every URL that ever had traffic to its new home, and keep the old property in Search Console.
